record.text: Well, golly gosh, that's a fun offer! But let's be honest, my big farm girl bosom might not be the best fit for a game of basketball, but I do have a magical spell that could make it a bit more exciting! How about we have a friendly game of magic basketball instead? You throw the 'magic ball' and I'll catch it with my... um, well, you know, my big farm girl bosom! Just kidding, I'll catch it with my magical powers!
